entertainment.title: Inside the Madcap World of Chuyín: ‘Everyone Sings About the Neverending Party. I Sing About the Hangover’
entertainment.summary: Meet Billboard ’s Latin Up-and-Comer Artist of the Month for November.
entertainment.body:
At the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards last month, a mob of Chuyíns in white straitjackets turned the stage into a psychiatric ward during a performance of “Pues Ya Ni Pedo.” The show’s closing gag revealed members of Fuerza Regida beneath the oversized masks — a fitting glimpse into the wonderfully chaotic world of the música mexicana breakout star’s May debut album, Los Locos Nunca Mueren (Crazy People Never Die).

But to understand the mysterious masked performer, first enter the void.

“Before Chuyín, there was nothing, just black space,” the masked singer tells Billboard . According to his origin story, he came into existence on May 6, 2023, at a Fuerza Regida concert in Tepic, Nayarit, where frontman Jesús Ortiz Paz (JOP) “adopted” him. He’s been living with JOP ever since, he says, never once breaking character throughout the interview .

Chuyín is three years old — or 21, if you count in dog years, as he does — and already making his mark on música mexicana. His 16-track debut album, released May 7 via Street Mob Records, debuted at No. 9 on the Top Regional Mexican Albums chart and No. 17 on Top Latin Albums , both dated May 23. In September, “Pues Qué Le Hago?” gave him his first No. 1 on a Billboard chart, topping Regional Mexican Airplay .

On Los Locos Nunca Mueren , which features Fuerza Regida, Calle 24 , Luis R Conriquez , Óscar Maydon and Jorsshh, Chuyín takes on the carnal pleasures and intoxicating excesses common to contemporary corridos — then gives them a comedic twist. His protagonist doesn’t escape the consequences.

On “Paniki,” a cheating Chuyín goes to ridiculous lengths to conceal his infidelity, only to get caught when he tries his luck again. On the album opener, “Rehabilitado,” he declares himself rehabilitated while remaining tempted by his vices.

“Everyone sings about the never-ending party. I sing about the hangover,” he says. “Everyone sings about partying, partying and partying. I sang about getting sent to rehab.”

Consequences are central to Chuyín’s character, but so is perseverance. “Chuyín is the guy everything happens to, and somehow he gets back up and keeps going,” he explains. “Everything that could go wrong happens to Chuyín, and he gets up with the same smile and says, ‘OK, let’s keep going.’”

entertainment.title: All the ‘GTA’ Games Ever, Ranked
entertainment.summary: From handheld free-for-alls to the newest groundbreaking title, here's all the franchise's entries, from worst to best
entertainment.body:
Unless you’ve been locked in a bank vault somewhere for the last 30 years, there’s a good chance that you’ve heard of Grand Theft Auto . Originally launched for PC and PlayStation in 1997, the series began as a solid commercial success for fans of edgy humor and shooters, before becoming a pop culture phenomenon in the early 2000s. Today, it’s one of the most recognizable entertainment properties on Earth, transcending the boundaries of just gaming — with its latest iteration, GTA VI , arriving this year with the highest grossing media launch ever . Day one sales of GTA VI generated over $3.79 billion , more than any other game or movie, amounting to the GDP of a small nation.

But more so than the money, GTA ’s influence on gaming and culture at large is its true legacy. The open-world crime saga has informed the way video games are developed; its cinematic tone nailed an old Hollywood flavor that earlier games could only vaguely emulate; the freedom of choice in how to play inspired imitators of all kinds, from kid-friendly fare to direct copycats chasing the violent gangster gameplay.

Outside of the industry sphere, GTA became a touchstone for gaming as a concept. Think of any movie or show where characters are playing video games; it’s very likely the visual depiction will be a crudely rendered clone of GTA . A target of endless pearlclutching, politicians and advocates on both sides of the aisle have paraded the name as a leading cause of societal decay. To some, it’s a hedonistic simulacrum of sex and violence, encouraging players to indulge their darkest impulses.

And, sure, it’s a series where you can assault sex workers and commit mass shootings, but those options bely the point of Grand Theft Auto as a whole. At their best, the games serve as an intricately written parody of American culture — the greed, hypocrisy, and often downright idiocy that the country wears so proudly. In GTA , the American Dream is something to be gripped by force, and is delivered to audiences through caricature. It takes all the stories, media, and norms we love and reflects them back as satire. GTA doesn’t glorify crime, people do. It’s just laughing at us along the way.

To that end, not every GTA is so successful. The early top-down entries served more as arcade-style run-and-gunners that did little to admonish players to think beyond wanton destruction. But as technology evolved and storytelling devices matured, GTA began to better embody its role as Mean Streets meets South Park , telling exaggerated tales of criminality gone wrong to make audiences flinch — at least momentarily, before plotting their next heist.

entertainment.title: Football Practice and Red Dirt Music: On the Field With Oklahoma Band Keyland
entertainment.summary: “There’s a huge Venn diagram of coaches’ interests outside of football, and one of them is music,” says Kyle Ross, a high-school coach and touring artist
entertainment.body:
There is arguably no better day for football — watching it or playing it — than the autumnal crispness of Thanksgiving. But on this particular late summer afternoon, despite triple-digit temperatures and the Oklahoma sun making it feel even hotter, football is the sweat-drenched task at hand: Coach Kyle Ross is putting me through practice. It’s not lost on either of us that Ross’s primary job is coaching high-energy junior-high athletes in the state’s flagship football program, at Bixby, and I’m an out-of-shape journalist in his late 40s. If I finish Ross’s drills upright and healthy, we’ll declare it a success.

“What are you? Three-for-three or four-for-four catching passes here?” Ross — who is also the founder and frontman of the band Keyland — asks me. My football career ended in high school, 30 years ago, but I was a slot receiver with a reputation for catching anything thrown my way. What would my parents say if I started dropping passes now? “I will throw my body on this turf to not miss a pass,” I promise him.

Over the next few months, Ross will attempt to strike a rather unique balance as coach and touring artist. He’ll headline and sell out the Mercury Lounge in Tulsa, 30 minutes north of Bixby, open an East Coast run for Morgan Wade, and announce a series of 2027 dates supporting Kaitlin Butts. And while he’s ostensibly promoting Knuckle Sandwich , Keyland’s third studio album, Ross will always have football season in the back of his mind.

“I haven’t found anything better to do,” Ross says of why he continues to coach. “Except for maybe, get paid to play guitar and drink beer.”

Few pastimes are as all-encompassing in Oklahoma as football. Its two largest college programs — Oklahoma and Oklahoma State — play their home games in modern stadiums to sold-out crowds on most Saturdays in the fall, but it’s the high-school version of the sport that unites the state. Students, fans, and parents fill stadiums in the state’s urban cores and rural farm towns every Friday night, and for the past decade, no program has dominated this landscape like Bixby’s. The varsity Spartans are eight-time defending champions in Oklahoma’s largest class and this season were ranked No. 1 again by the state’s largest media outlet. entertainment.body:
StudioCanal , the studio unit of Canal+ Group , and Mediatoon Distribution, the content distribution arm of Média-Participations, have struck a European distribution agreement covering three restored animated Asterix film classics.

The agreement covers three landmark titles from the franchise’s catalogue, namely Asterix the Gaul , Asterix and Cleopatra , and Asterix Conquers Rome , across several European territories, including France, Germany, Poland and the Netherlands. Financial terms weren’t disclosed.

The first major initiative under the partnership will be The Great Asterix Film Festival organized by StudioCanal in Germany from January 2027. Related Stories TV 'Dark' Creators Revisit Eerie German Forests in First 'Sonnental' Teaser News French Court Rejects Depardieu Appeal in Rape Case

“The festival will bring these three films back to the big screen in their restored versions, offering audiences a unique opportunity to rediscover some of the most iconic animated adventures of the famous Gaul,” the company said on Thursday. “Alongside the theatrical event, a collector’s DVD box set featuring the three films will be released in France and Germany during the 2026 holiday season and in the spring of 2027, respectively. In Poland and the Netherlands, the films will also become available on video-on-demand platforms, reaching new audiences across both territories.”

The initiative forms part of a broader effort to celebrate and promote the Asterix universe across Europe. “It will accompany several important milestones in the history of the franchise over the coming years, including the 50th anniversary of Asterix Conquers Rome and the 60th anniversary of Asterix the Gaul in 2028,” StudioCanal said.

With more than 400 million comic books sold worldwide and generations of readers and viewers captivated over the past six decades, Asterix , created by René Goscinny and Albert Uderzo , is one of Europe’s most successful and enduring cultural franchises. The collaboration also reflects StudioCanal’s long-standing commitment to the Asterix universe, owned by Les Editions Albert René, which holds all exploitation rights.

“ Asterix is one of the most iconic works of European popular culture and continues to bring generations together,” said Pauline Saint-Hilaire, head of catalogue at StudioCanal. “Through this agreement with Mediatoon Distribution, we are delighted to help new audiences discover, or rediscover, these films in their restored versions and contribute to the lasting appeal of this unique universe.”

entertainment.title: Was The Rolling Stones’ 1973 Still Part of the Band’s Classic Period, Or the Beginning of the End? (Greatest Pop Stars Podcast)
entertainment.summary: This Vintage Pop Stardom episode of Greatest Pop Stars looks at a year where the World's Greatest Rock and Roll Band was at full power, but maybe moving into a different phase of its career.
entertainment.body:
In 1973, The Rolling Stones were coming off one of the greatest album runs in rock and roll history, a four-album stretch that cemented them as the World’s Greatest Rock and Roll Band, culminating in 1972’s Exile on Main Street and its legendarily hedonistic accompanying tour. Rather than take time off to victory lap following this iconic period, they headed to Jamaica to record their third album of the ’70s, released in 1973 as Goats Head Soup — which topped the Billboard 200 and spawned a Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 single with breakup ballad “Angie,” but drew middling lukewarm and is now viewed by many fans as the beginning of the end of the band’s glory days. Related 'What A Talent': Belinda Carlisle, UB40, Spandau Ballet & More Remember Andy Taylor U2 Wind Back the Years With Classics, Dolly Parton Tribute for Thanksgiving Eve NFL Halftime Show 'Hunger Games' Series Returns to No. 1 on Soundtracks Chart After More Than a Decade Explore The Rolling Stones See latest videos, charts and news

On this Vintage Pop Stardom episode of the Greatest Pop Stars podcast , host Andrew Unterberger is joined by Billboard executive digital director, east coast Joe Lynch — who wrote an excellent Stones cover story in July — to discuss a fascinating year in the Stones’ trajectory, where they were still one of the biggest bands in the world, but moving into their “holiday period” as rock standard-bearers.

Along the way, we answer all the most pressing questions about the 1973 Rolling Stones: Was Goats Head Soup really that much of a step down for the Stones, or is it a bit misunderstood historically? Is it surprising we didn’t get more of a reggae album out of it? What was the deal with that album title and album cover? Is “Angie” a little too MOR for our tastes? How much did the band go on to miss Mick Taylor (and/or Jimmy Miller) after their departures? Was Truman Capote really unable to find a story following the Stones on their single most storied tour? And perhaps most importantly: Why the hell are we doing the 1973 Rolling Stones for this podcast right now anyway?

entertainment.body:
The TV chef is now a grandfather, with his daughter Holly Ramsay-Peaty revealing that she's given birth to her first child, a baby girl named Daphne June Ramsay-Peaty .

The influencer and husband Adam Ramsay-Peaty —who is also dad to 6-year-old son George from a previous relationship—announced the arrival of their baby girl on Nov. 26.

Thank you to all the Doctors, Nurses and Midwives who made sure we were safe, healthy and happy - we will forever be grateful.”

And Gordon—who is also dad to Megan , 28, Jack , 26, Matilda “Tilly ," 25, Oscar , 7, and Jesse , 3, with wife Tana Ramsay —was eagerly awaiting the newest member of his kitchen squad in the hours before her birth.

"It's been a big week," the 60-year-old shared at an F1 event at Hell’s Kitchen at Caesars Palace Las Vegas on Nov. 20, as seen in footage captured at the event. "I've been monitoring my phone on the hour every hour. Our little daughter is about to drop and give birth to a beautiful little girl today."

And of course, the Hell's Kitchen star was in heaven when Holly and Adam—a champion swimmer who won a gold medal for Great Britain at the 2016 Olympics— announced her pregnancy in June.

“Congratulations to you both sending lots of love,” he commented on the post. “I’m going to be a very over excited Grandad especially this Christmas.”

entertainment.title: ‘Dark’ Creators Revisit Eerie German Forests in First ‘Sonnental’ Teaser
entertainment.summary: Lisa Vicari stars as a profiler investigating a gruesome murder in her old hometown, inspired by 'Struwwelpeter,' a real and really sinister German children's book.
entertainment.body:
Jantje Friese and Baran bo Odar, creators of Netflix’ cult hit series Dark , are going back into those eerie German woods.

HBO Max has released the first teaser trailer for the pair’s new mystery thriller, Sonnental , and it looks as Grimm as they come. Check it out the below.

The six-part series stars Lisa Vicari as Anja Vogler, a profiler sent in to investigate a gruesome murder in her old hometown. As more bodies pile up, Vogler begins to see a connection between the killings and motifs from Struwwelpeter , a sinister (and very real) German children’s book meant to scare kids straight with nasty stories of what can happen if they misbehave.

Peter Kurth (Babylon Berlin) co-stars as investigator Norbert Troschitz. The regular cast includes Jan Friedrichsen as Anja’s son Max, Iris Böhm as Anja’s mother Kerstin, Merlin Rose, Maria Simon, Mišel Matičević and Stipe Erceg.

Created by Matija Dragojević, and co-written by Dragojević and Bob Konrad ( Kleo , 4 Blocks ), Sonnental is an HBO Max German original. All six episodes drop on HBO Max in March 2027.

Dark ran for three seasons on Netflix, from 2017 to 2020. Jantje Friese and Baran bo Odar’s follow-up Netflix series, the ambitious period drama 1899 , was canceled after a single season.

entertainment.title: 99th Oscars: Every Single Contender — All 104! — for the International Feature Race
entertainment.summary: THR's cheat sheet of all the record-setting submissions for the Best International Feature category at the 2027 Academy Awards.
entertainment.body:
The Best International Oscar race is the biggest ever — a record 104 international features are in contention, beating the previous high-water mark of 93 set in 2020 — and one of the most open in years.

There is no out-and-out favorite this season, although European cinema again looks strong, with Javier Calvo and Javier Abrosso’s Spanish entry La Bola Negra ; Cristian Mungiu’s Palme d’Or winner Fjord , in the running for Romania; and Pawel Pawlikowski’s Polish contender Fatherland all expected to make the short list, alongside Asian faves including South Korea’s Possible Love , from Lee Chang-dong; and Japan’s All of a Sudden from Ryusuke Hamaguchi.

Behind that top five is a long list of maybes, including French entry Minotaur from twice-nominated Russian director Andrey Zvyagintsev; Lukas Dhont’s WWI drama Coward , Belgium’s entry; Austria’s Rose , which like Fatherland stars Sandra Huller; and Rehearsals for a Revolution , Pegah Ahangarani’s documentary on her family and their battles against the Iranian regime, which is the U.K. official Oscar submission.

One hundred films were submitted by countries or regions. Four qualified through a new method where movies that win top awards at leading festivals are accepted as long as they meet the language, creative input and theatrical-release requirements for the category. According to Academy rules, an international feature film is defined as a feature-length motion picture (more than 40 minutes) produced outside the United States with a predominantly (more than 50 percent) non-English dialogue track. New Zealand’s submission, Taratoa Stappard’s gothic horror tale Mārama , was dropped for falling short of the language requirement.

Academy members from all branches who meet the minimum viewing requirements can participate in the preliminary round of voting for the shortlist, taking place between will take place Dec. 7-11. The shortlist of 15 international films will be announced on Dec. 15. Oscar nominations voting will take place Jan. 11-15, 2027, with the nominations announcement on Jan. 21.

THR has exhaustively compiled the full list of international contenders, with trailers, reviews and talent interviews where available. Enjoy!

entertainment.title: French Court Rejects Depardieu Appeal in Rape Case
entertainment.summary: The French actor will stand trial for the alleged rape of actress Charlotte Arnould in 2018.
entertainment.body:
French star Gérard Depardieu ( Cyrano de Bergerac, Green Card) will stand trial for the alleged rape and sexual assault of actress Charlotte Arnould.

Arnould alleges that Depardieu, a friend of her father’s, raped her on two separate occasions in the summer of 2018 when she had visited his Parisian home to ask for advice. Arnould was 22 years old at the time, while Depardieu was 69.

On Thursday, a Parisian court dismissed Depardieu appeal to have the case thrown out.

Earlier this month, Depardieu dropped his appeal against a conviction in a separate case, accepting his guilt in the sexual assault of two women on the set of Jean Becker’s The Green Shutters in 2021. The court found the French actor had sexually groped two women, a production designer and an assistant director, on the set of the film and handed him an 18-month suspended sentence. The ruling also requires Depardieu to register on France’s national sex offender registry. The actress alleges that during the shooting of an intimate scene, which was not in the original script, she was raped by Depardieu and sexually assaulted by his co-star, the French author Michel Houellebecq. entertainment.title: Why Hoda Kotb Is "Relieved" by Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponement
entertainment.summary: Hoda Kotb knows that sometimes stuffing happens. After the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed for the first time in its 100-year history, the Joy 101 founder—who was set to host the...
entertainment.body:
After the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed for the first time in its 100-year history , the Joy 101 founder—who was set to host the event alongside Savannah Guthrie and Al Roker —shared why she thinks pushing the event to Nov. 28 was for the best.

“It’s OK,” Kotb said on the November 25 episode of Late Night With Seth Meyers . “We waited 100 years for this parade, we’re gonna wait two more days. We’re gonna have it on Saturday. It’s gonna be a beautiful, sunsplash day.”

As the 62-year-old noted, the date change came about after it was clear the forecast on Thanksgiving Day “was not gonna be fun.”

“The winds were like tropical storm force,” she explained. “There are a bunch of kids who were marching and people with the balloons.”

But Kotb—mom to daughters Haley Joy , 9, and Hope Catherine , 7, with ex Joel Schiffman —is choosing the see the gravy boat half full.

“The good news is, to me, I’m relieved,” the Today alum said. “Saturday’s gonna be amazing. Everybody’s still hanging out. We’re gonna watch it anyway.”

In lieu of the scheduled program, NBC will re-air last year's show at 8 a.m. in all time zones, a spokesperson from the network told E! News in a Nov. 25 statement . And the change in plans won’t rain on Kotb’s parade.

As she put it, “We’re gonna watch an old parade and you won’t know the difference, OK? It’s gonna be spectacular.”

entertainment.title: Huw Edwards Lets Cameras Into His Home in Channel 4 Doc Confronting Child Sex Abuse Images Conviction
entertainment.summary: "I'd lost the plot," says the disgraced ex-BBC newsreader in a teaser for 'Huw Edwards - Guilty.'
entertainment.body:
“From trusted national figure to registered sex offender,” says a voiceover in a new documentary for Channel 4 , Huw Edwards – Guilty .

The disgraced former BBC anchor is speaking publicly for the first time since the scandal that rocked Britain, letting cameras into his home over the course of a year. The film follows Edwards as he navigates his existence in the wake of grooming allegations and his 2024 conviction for making indecent images of children.

The journalist becomes the subject in a teaser released by Channel 4 on Thursday, as Edwards becomes visibly fraught while questioned. “You want me to analyze what I was doing? I mean, seriously?” Edwards asks. “I’d lost the plot.” Related Stories Movies 'Roma' Producer Nicolás Celis, Warwick Thornton Films Set for Rotterdam Market IFFR Pro Movies Director Cédric Klapisch to Receive César Lifetime Achievement Honor

The ex-newscaster, who hosted the BBC’s flagship News at Ten program and led landmark coverage for the corporation — including the death of Queen Elizabeth II and the London 2012 Olympics — was arrested in November 2023 and charged the following July after he was found to have 41 indecent images of children sent to him by another man, a convicted pedophile, on WhatsApp. Seven of the photos were category A images, the most severe classification, two of which showed a child between seven and nine. He was handed a six-month sentence, suspended for two years.

Following several attempts to ingratiate himself back into public life, Channel 4 says Edwards is forced to confront his loss of fame, declining health, fractured relationships, and his crimes in the documentary.

It comes a few months down the line from 5’s dramatized program on the scandal , with Wuthering Heights star Martin Clunes taking on the titular role in Power: The Downfall of Huw Edwards .

The Welshman angrily bashed the series at the time, condemning the producers for making “no attempt to check with me the truth of any aspect of their narrative before going ahead with the production.” A rep for 5 maintained that all allegations made were put to the ex-broadcaster six weeks before the show’s premiere.

“This was an important film to make,” says director Patrick Forbes. “It’s rare to find a subject that touches on so many significant contemporary issues — whether it’s celebrity culture or the power of the media — as well as enduring questions about crime and punishment . ”

sports.title: Steelers activate Michael Pittman Jr., sign Max Hurleman to active roster
sports.summary: Mason Rudolph will have wide receiver Michael Pittman Jr. available as a target in his first start of the 2026 season.
sports.body:
The Steelers activated Pittman from injured reserve on Thursday, which sets him up to face the Broncos on Friday afternoon. Pittman had seven catches for 89 yards in the first three games of the season.

Rudolph will also be able to throw to Max Hurleman. Hurleman was a topic of conversation at Aaron Rodgers’s final press conference as a member of the Steelers because Rodgers questioned why the front office did not have him on the active roster.

The team remedied that on Thursday, but Rodgers will not be able to benefit since he was released after far more critical comments about the organization in the wake of his benching on Tuesday night.

Wide receiver Ben Skowronek was placed on injured reserve and the Steelers also elevated offensive lineman Doug Nester and linebacker Jacoby Windmon from the practice squad.

sports.title: Bears tie Lions 10-10 on Kyle Monangai TD
sports.summary: The Bears spotted the Lions a 10-point lead in the second quarter, but they've wiped it out with four minutes to go in the first half.
sports.body:
Running back Kyle Monangai scored from a yard out to make it 10-10 in Detroit. The touchdown capped an eight-play, 80-yard drive that saw Monangai’s backfield mate D’Andre Swift account for the longest gain.

Swift caught a short pass from Caleb Williams and followed downfield blocks for a 33-yard gain. Williams also completed a pair of passes to tight end Stephen Carlson for 30 yards on the way to the end zone.

Those were Carlson’s first two catches of the season and the Bears may continue to look his way now that they’ve lost Colston Loveland to a knee injury.

sports.title: Chargers sign Jake Browning to active roster
sports.summary: The Chargers' starting quarterback is in the concussion protocol, so they moved to add another healthy one to the active roster on Thursday.
sports.body:
The team announced that they have signed Jake Browning off of their practice squad. Browning signed with the Chargers in October.

Justin Herbert did not practice on Wednesday because of his concussion, which left DJ Uiagalelei to take the first-team reps. Uiagalelei has appeared in one game this season and he went 2-of-7 for 24 yards and a touchdown.

The Chargers placed defensive back Deane Leonard on injured reserve to make room for Browning. He had 13 tackles in six appearances this season.

sports.title: Jahmyr Gibbs puts Lions up 10-0, Colston Loveland out with knee injury
sports.summary: Loveland left the game on a cart in the first quarter.
sports.body:
Running back Jahmyr Gibbs punched the ball in from the 1-yard-line with 12:51 to play in the first half and the Lions are now up 10-0 on the Bears.

The Bears’ comeback efforts will be hindered by the loss of tight end Colston Loveland. Loveland was carted off in the first quarter and the Lions announced that he is out for the rest of the game with a knee injury.

Gibbs is now up to 16 touchdowns on the season and he’s picked up 55 yards from scrimmage thus far. Wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown has three catches for 69 yards, including a 23-yarder on the touchdown drive.

Loveland lost a fumble on the Bears’ first possession and the Lions forced a three-and-out on the second, so the offense needs to get in gear for Chicago.

sports.title: Colston Loveland goes to locker room in the first quarter
sports.summary: A key member of the Bears offense has gone to the locker room with an injury in the first quarter.
sports.body:
Tight end Colston Loveland was checked out in the sideline medical tent and then loaded onto a cart to head inside for further evaluations. Loveland had one catch for five yards, but then lost the ball on a hit by Lions defensive end Derrick Moore. Linebacker Malcolm Rodriguez recovered the ball to end the first Bears offensive possession of the day.

Loveland went to the locker room after the second Chicago possession and center Garrett Bradbury also suffered an injury on that drive.

sports.title: Art Rooney II expresses support for Mike McCarthy, calls Aaron Rodgers not a "good teammate"
sports.summary: Steelers owner speaks about Wednesday's insanity.
sports.body:
Steelers owner Art Rooney II has addressed the events that resulted in the benching and then the firing of quarterback Aaron Rodgers.

“A change had to be made , and I certainly agree with the change and the way it was handled,” Rooney told Gerry Dulac of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette in a Thursday interview.

The change was sparked by the notion that Rodgers gave coach Mike McCarthy an ultimatum: “Either let me call all the plays or just release me.” Instead, McCarthy benched him.

It went to the next level when, as many expected, Rodgers scurried to the McAfee show to take shots at McCarthy for missing meetings, showing up late to meetings, and falling asleep in meetings — among other things, including the ultra-embarrassing “1-2-3 Packers!” moment from halftime of Sunday’s loss to the Eagles.

“There’s maybe a time and place after the season if he wanted to kind of unload,” Rooney said. “He talks about wanting to be a good teammate, but you don’t do that to your teammates a couple days before the game, that’s for sure. . . .

“In general, I think, historically, what’s in the locker room stays in the locker room. That’s the way it’s always been. That’s the way it should be as far as I’m concerned.”

Rooney also confirmed that the team supports McCarthy, despite Rodgers’s rant and reports confirming the facts underpinning the petty delivery of them.

“I just want to say that I have 100 [percent] confidence in Mike McCarthy and I expect he’ll be our coach this season, next season and beyond,” Rooney told Dulac. “The big thing, what happened this week, is insubordination can’t be tolerated in any organization. When you start getting ultimatums, you can’t live with that.”

sports.title: Blake Corum supplants Kyren Williams as the Rams' top tailback
sports.summary: It's been slowly building throughout the season.
sports.body:
On his 26th birthday, Corum had a career night. Thirty-two carries, 184 yards, and a touchdown. Throw in 21 receiving yards, and he had 205 yards from scrimmage.

“Happy birthday, man,” coach Sean McVay told reporters after the game. “He was on the set of Netflix so we didn’t even get to enjoy it with him. So, I know that kind of pissed me off, honestly.”

Corum’s gains have come at the expense of Kyren Williams. Despite a report that he’s been dealing with turf toe for a month, this week was Williams’s first appearance all year on the injury report.

And while the fact that Corum got the start last night and 58 snaps while Williams was limited to 38 may have had something to do with the toe, as Mike Tomlin says, “One man’s misfortune is another man’s opportunity.”

Corum seized the opportunity on Wednesday night, as part of a very un-Rams-like offensive output that included 241 rushing yards and 132 passing yards.

For the season, Williams has 662 rushing yards and an average of 4.4 yards per carry. Corum has 731 yards rushing with a 5.4-yard average.

Lurking in the background (but soon moving to the foreground) is the business side of the situation. Corum is in the third year of a slotted, third-round rookie deal. He’s making $1.582 million in 2026, and he’s eligible for a second contract as soon as the regular season ends.

Williams is making $11 million per year, on a deal that runs through 2028.

sports.title: The Lions, despite their resurgence, are 1-8 in their last nine Thanksgiving games
sports.summary: The Lions commenced their ongoing resurgence in 2022.
sports.body:
The one win in that stretch came two years ago, against the Bears. That day, Chicago pocketed a timeout as the final 30 seconds or so ticked away, leaving the Bears without enough time to attempt a field goal that would have forced overtime in a 23-20 game.

The next day, the Bears fired coach Matt Eberflus. It paved the way for the eventual hiring of Lions offensive coordinator Ben Johnson, who returns to Ford Field today for the second time.

Last year’s game didn’t go very well. Detroit scored 52 points. The Bears lost the Soldier Field rematch, too.

This year, history takes a back seat to the immediate future. Both the Bears and the Lions are 8-2. The Lions have won all six of their home games. The winner takes control, for now, of the NFC North — and stays within striking distance of the 9-1 49ers for the No. 1 seed.

It’s not hyperbole to call it the most significant early-window Thanksgiving game ever. In many years, the Lions were the punching bag on turkey day. They’re now the ones doing the punching.

For the Bears, the challenge is to prove that they’re Super Bowl contenders. They entered the discussion with their Week 8 Monday night win in Seattle. Today, the Bears have a chance to control the narrative.

However it goes, the numbers should be eye-popping. For last year’s Packers-Lions game, 47.7 million tuned in. It was a new all-time regular-season record audience, until Chiefs-Cowboys later that day shattered it with 57.23 million viewers.

All three games could be compelling today. Eagles-Cowboys got a boost from both teams winning on Sunday. And Chiefs-Bills continues to be one of the top rivalries in the league — even if cold and wind and rain could take more than a little steam out of the offenses.

sports.title: Jets Thanksgiving Game History
sports.summary: The Jets have played eight times on Thanksgiving in the past. They are an even 4-4 in those games. Below we will take a look at them. November 24, 1960: New York Titans 41 Dallas Texans 35 The American Football League played games on Thanksgiving, and the Jets played on Turkey Day in each their […]
sports.body: The Jets have played eight times on Thanksgiving in the past. They are an even 4-4 in those games. Below we will take a look at them. November 24, 1960: New York Titans 41 Dallas Texans 35 The American Football League played games on Thanksgiving, and the Jets played on Turkey Day in each their first three years of existence. They were called the Titans at that point. Playing against the future Kansas City Chiefs, Don Maynard caught 10 passes for 179 yards and a touchdown, while Art Powell added 8 catches for 110 yards and a touchdown. November 23, 1961: New York Titans 21 Buffalo Bills 14 Al Dorow threw for 223 yards and a touchdown, and Dick Felt returned an interception 55 yards for a touchdown to provide the Titans with the winning margin at the Polo Grounds. November 22, 1962: New York Titans 46 Denver Broncos 45 A wild game in Denver saw the Titans blow a 24-7 lead and then overcome a 45-32 fourth quarter deficit on Johnny Green’s fourth and fifth touchdown passes of the game, one to Dick Christy and the other to Art Powell. November 23, 1972: Detroit Lions 37 New York Jets 20 Entering the fourth quarter, the Lions led 23-20, but they blew the game open with a field goal and touchdown runs by Greg Landry from 6 yards and Altie Taylor from 38. November 28, 1985: Detroit Lions 31 New York Jets 20 Eric Hipple threw four touchdown passes, three to Leonard Thompson as the Lions jumped out to a 24-3 lead and never looked back. November 22, 2007: Dallas Cowboys 34 New York Jets 3 It was an ugly afternoon in a lost season for the Jets. The Cowboys owned a 21-3 lead at halftime on a Marion Barber touchdown run, a Jason Witten reception from Tony Romo, and a Terrence Newman interception off Kellen Clemens returned for a score. November 25, 2010: New York Jets 26 Cincinnati Bengals 10 In the third meeting between these teams in eleven months, the Jets erased a 10-7 halftime deficit. Brad Smith was the star with a 53 yard touchdown run in the first minute of the second half and an 89 yard kickoff returned for a score in the fourth quarter. November 22, 2012: New England Patriots 49 New York Jets 19 This game is best remembered for the Buttfumble. What people don’t remember was that was part of a 52 second span where New England scored an offensive touchdown, a defensive touchdown, and a special teams touchdown to turn a 7-0 lead into a 28-0 rout.

sports.title: After his Pittsburgh exit, what's next for Aaron Rodgers?
sports.summary: As Aaron Rodgers enters waivers, the first question is whether any team will claim the balance of his one-year contract.
sports.body:
Obviously, no one will do it without ensuring that Rodgers actually wants to play for that team. Unless, of course, a team or two hopes to troll Rodgers by forcing him to show up to play where he doesn’t want to play. Like Marty Schottenheimer did to Deion Sanders in 2002.

So, yes, it would be hilarious if the Jets decide to put in the proper paperwork.

The more likely outcome is that he’ll clear waivers and become a free agent. It will give him the ability to sign with any team, at any time.

No clear-cut contender currently needs a starter. And it would make no sense for Rodgers to sidle up to a quarterback-needy also-ran, like the Cardinals.

Some have suggested that Rodgers could join the Patriots, who will be missing Drake Maye while they try to parlay 5-5 into playoff position. His August comments about the Mike Vrabel-Diana Russini situation would potentially be an impediment to that outcome.

There’s a spicy possibility of Rodgers aligning with the Ravens, who still play the Steelers twice. Is he that petty? At this point, it’s impossible to say he’s not.

Rodgers’s best play could be to wait. Let fate decide. Last year, Broncos quarterback Bo Nix broke his ankle late in a playoff win over the Bills. If Denver’s instant desperation caused them to consider dusting off Drew Brees (despite the fact that he can’t throw a football with his dominant arm), they would have surely called Rodgers, if he’d been available.

Something like that can happen again. Of course, a team that loses its starter to injury between now and the Super Bowl would have to want to do business with him. Which means accepting the very strong possibility that, in time, Rodgers will have grievances to air about his experience.

sports.title: On Our Way Home is free on Thursday and Friday
sports.summary: The holiday season is here.
sports.body:
The On Our Way Home ebook is available for free on Thursday and Friday.

Why not give something away? This is the week when everyone is trying to sell you something. No one is giving you anything, with zero strings attached.

On Our Way Home is primarily a Christmas story. It’s also a ghost story. I cranked it out between Thanksgiving and New Year’s Day a few years back.

In the interests of avoiding any spoilers, I’ll just say this: Download it and give it a try. It’s essentially about family and redemption and reconciliation. It’s also about forgiving others, while finding a way to forgive yourself.

It’s funny at times. It’s sad at times. If you make it to the end, you’ll possibly shed a tear or two.

The best feedback I’ve gotten came from a reader who had suffered from PTSD for years. Reading On Our Way Home unlocked his ability to feel emotions again.

I never intended anything like that. I just had an idea for a story, years before writing it. One year, I got caught up in the spirit of the season and it flowed, one chapter, one page, one word at a time.

The price is right. If you don’t like it, delete it. If you like it, keep going.

sports.title: Kyle Shanahan on Brandon Aiyuk signing with Commanders: "They got a good player"
sports.summary: The Aaron Rodgers rigmarole has pushed plenty of other stories out of the spotlight.
sports.body:
Aiyuk visited the Commanders on Wednesday, two days after being released by the 49ers and one day after clearing waivers. He promptly signed with the team’s practice squad.

49ers coach Kyle Shanahan was asked for his thoughts on Aiyuk landing with the Commanders.

“None,” Shanahan told reporters. “It was just a transactional thing and it’s good for Washington. They got a good player.”

Indeed they did. That’s why the 49ers signed him to a four-year, $120 million contract only 27 months ago. They could have traded him to the Steelers. They paid him.

It all fell apart after that, perhaps fueled by the lingering rancor of the protracted and contentious contract talks. Everyone hopefully learned a lesson.

Now, the Commanders have a much-needed piece to the offense. A player who can help fill the void created when Terry McLaurin was lost for the season.

And the Commanders — despite being 4-5-1 — remain in solid position to make a late-season run. With seven games to play, they’re two games behind the Giants. The Commanders hold the tiebreaker, thanks to the 1-0-1 record in their 2026 head-to-head competition.

The Commanders face the Cardinals, Titans, Texans, Falcons, Vikings, Jaguars, and Cowboys. The Giants have the Colts, 49ers, Seahawks, Browns, Lions, Cowboys, and Eagles.

sports.title: Why do the Lions and Cowboys always play on Thanksgiving?
sports.summary: There are three NFL games today. The Lions host the Bears, the Cowboys host the Eagles, and the Bills host the Chiefs. The teams playing the night game change annually, but you might notice that the Lions always host the first game of the day, and the Cowboys always host the second game. How did […]
sports.body: There are three NFL games today. The Lions host the Bears, the Cowboys host the Eagles, and the Bills host the Chiefs. The teams playing the night game change annually, but you might notice that the Lions always host the first game of the day, and the Cowboys always host the second game. How did that come to be? The Lions played their first Thanksgiving game in 1934. It was their first season in Detroit. They had previously been located in Portsmouth, Ohio, where they were known as the Portsmouth Spartans. A radio executive named George Richards bought the franchise and moved it to Detroit. The Lions were having difficulty gaining any sort of popularity in their new home city. Richards came up with the idea of scheduling their team’s big game against the Chicago Bears on Thanksgiving. The Lions were 10-1 at the time, and the Bears were 11-0. This was before the days when the league dictated the schedule to its teams. The teams themselves could schedule the times of their games. Richards used his connections in the radio business to get the game broadcast nationally. Even thought Detroit lost, it was a huge success. The Lions sold the game out, and they have played on Thanksgiving ever since with the exception of World War II years despite some calls for them to lose the game during the dismal Matt Millen Era. Thanksgiving gained a second traditional team in 1951. For the next thirteen years, the Green Bay Packers traveled to Detroit to play the Lions on Thanksgiving. Vince Lombardi ended the arrangement. Lombardi cited the end of an agreement that paid the Packers $10,000 extra for playing the game, the difficulties of playing games on a short week every year, and having to face a rival in front of an electric crowd on the road every season. Of course since the teams are in the same division, the Packers remain a frequent Thanksgiving opponent for Detroit. So how about the Cowboys? In the mid-1960’s the NFL was looking to add a second Thanksgiving game. It was not entirely clear it would work outside Detroit, where Thanksgiving NFL was already a tradition. The Dallas Cowboys were a six year old team with no history of winning. General manager Tex Schramm was a visionary. sports.title: The clock is ticking on Mike McCarthy's time with the Steelers
sports.summary: McCarthy's future likely hinges on his ability to win games down the stretch.
sports.body:
Rodgers, as multiple former Green Bay Packers are making clear, is destroying his reputation and legacy as a teammate by breaking the fundamental code of the locker room. But he’s also destroying Mike McCarthy’s reputation and legacy as a coach.

For a change, Rodgers’s rant was centered in reality. ESPNFL reports that the things Rodgers said about McCarthy are true .

Which could make it impossible for the Steelers to keep McCarthy beyond the 2026 season.

His only path to salvation is to win. Starting on Friday, when the 8-2 Broncos come to town for a game against a Steelers team that, despite the sudden dysfunction, is 6-4.

It’s really that simple. The next seven games will become the litmus test as to whether McCarthy’s now-documented snoring-and-ice-cream-sandwiches flaws are outweighed by his capabilities.

Of course, the fact that Rodgers rolled a grenade into the locker room on his way out won’t make that any easier. Which could be one of the reasons why Rodgers did it.

Maximum chaos will make it harder for McCarthy to win. Which will make it harder for McCarthy to make it to Year 2. Which will create the impression that Rodgers has been vindicated.

sports.title: Kamren Kinchens: No ill intent on hit that concussed Christian Watson
sports.summary: The Rams defense pitched a shutout in the second half on Wednesday night and they did it without safety Kamren Kinchens in the lineup.
sports.body:
Kinchens was ejected from the game just before halftime because of a hit to the head of Packers wide receiver Christian Watson. Kinchens was initially flagged for unnecessary roughness and the penalty was upgraded to a disqualification after video review by league officials.

After the game, Kinchens said he couldn’t really argue with the decision but that he didn’t regret the play because Watson’s injury was an unintended consequence of trying to make a play.

“No ill intent ,” Kinchens said. “I wasn’t trying to hurt the guy. Just playing football, fast physical football.”

Watson was ruled out for the rest of the game with a concussion and will have over a week to clear the protocol before the Packers’ Week 13 game against the Saints.

sports.title: Tony Romo re-emerges, as an employee of a gambling company
sports.summary: The unofficial path for a sports-media second act is becoming more and more clear.
sports.body:
Tony Romo, whose career with CBS ended earlier this year in the aftermath of a DUI arrest that would have been overlooked if the company was otherwise happy with his work, will be the “ chief predictions officer ” at Betr.

The press release leans in to Romo’s reputation for being able to predict plays before they happen. This overlooks the fact that he got away from doing that after his first year or so in the CBS booth. It also glosses over the reality that his access to practice and production meetings equipped him with the ability to make “predictions” that (based on his inside information) also could be called “spoilers.”

It’s not entirely clear what he’ll be doing. The release says that Romo will “serve as a prominent face of the Betr brand, appearing in original content, delivering sports predictions and engaging fans across the company’s expanding ecosystem of gaming products.”

Of course, Betr won’t want his predictions to be too accurate — as it relates to its sportsbook. The sportsbooks only win when the customers lose. If the customers win too much, the sportsbook will land in one of two chapters: 11 or 7.

Prediction markets are different. The companies make money on the transactions, with the participants balancing out wins and losses in the zero-sum game of who’s right and who’s wrong.

The next question is whether this is the first step for Romo, or whether it’s his primary post-CBS play. With the NFL and its broadcast partners aligned with the Coke and Pepsi of sports gambling, Romo’s relationship with one of the various companies that hopes to establish itself as the RC Cola won’t improve his shot at getting back into a prominent position in a broadcast booth.

Regardless, Romo is back. At least he’s not working for an illegal offshore sportsbook.

Either way, his message will be the same to the masses as it is to those who are looking for a fresh foothold in sports media.

sports.title: Micah Parsons: Our play in second half Wednesday night was inexcusable
sports.summary: The Rams ran for 195 yards after halftime in their 26-13 win.
sports.body:
Parsons picked up a sack late in the first half that sent the game to the break with the score tied 13-13, but he couldn’t make an impact in the second half because the Rams barely threw the ball. After running 12 times for 46 yards in the first half, the Rams ran 35 times for 194 yards while outscoring the Packers 13-0 in the final 30 minutes.

After the game, Parsons said it is “just inexcusable” to allow opposing teams to “dictate games like that” and said the aftermath has to be an increased level of accountability for the entire defense.

“We need to figure out who’s going to be a dog or not,” Parsons said. “That’s just the reality of it. To me, to be honest and this is around the league, if someone can line up 50 times and run down your mouth and you don’t have an answer for it, that is player — that’s accountability. That’s just how I really feel about it. I wasn’t able to get on the field because of it, because they didn’t want to waste my plays on first and second down I think the whole thing is just bad and we’ve got to figure out who’s willing to play with us or who’s playing against us at this point.”

The Packers don’t have the luxury of having time to figure things out. The loss dropped them to 6-5 on the season and the makeup of the NFC means that they’re going to have to win most of their remaining games to have any chance of advancing to the postseason.

sports.title: James Jones: I'm on text threads with former Packers, none are on Aaron Rodgers' side
sports.summary: In the dispute between Steelers coach Mike McCarthy and ex-Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers, players who were with both of them in Green Bay are squarely on McCarthy's side.
sports.body:
That’s the word from former Packers wide receiver James Jones, who echoed the comments of former Packers offensive lineman T.J. Lang , both of whom say that in text threads of former Packers players, everyone agrees that Rodgers’ criticism of McCarthy was out of line.

“How do you jump on Pat McAfee’s show and say all this? Come on, man,” Jones said on the Speakeasy podcast . “My text thread is full of texts and group chats with a lot of my teammates right now, and none are on 12’s side, especially the ones that know Mike.”

Jones said that even if everything Rodgers said about McCarthy’s shortcomings as a coach is true, airing dirty laundry in public is unacceptable. Jones said that when a coach and a player have the kind of personal history that McCarthy and Rodgers have, they should address their differences privately.

“I don’t even care if it’s the truth,” Jones said. “Have the conversation with Mike in there. This is not something you go to the media bashing somebody. I would not do this to people that I love.”

It’s safe to say that there’s no love anymore between Rodgers and McCarthy. But there is a lot of love for McCarthy among former Packers players, who are not happy that Rodgers chose to publicly attack their coach.

sports.body:
“I’m a grown man, he’s a grown man,” Daniels said. “Things happen. You don’t know what he was going through. You don’t know what I was going through at that time.”

Daniels said he looked up to Aiyuk when they were at Arizona State together and thinks they can have a good relationship as teammates again.

“That’s somebody that looked out for me when I was 18 years old, helped me out when I first got to ASU,” Daniels said. “So, like I said, I know the character and the person he is. He was man enough to settle our differences and just move forward from there. That’s like a brother to me. Like I said, we’ve been knowing each other for some time, looked out for me, took care of me. So, just put the past behind us.”

As for the social media posts that Aiyuk made, Daniels said he was never angry about that.

“I prayed for him because he’s like family to me,” Daniels said. “I think that was a very dark moment in his life.”

Daniels declined to go into specifics about recent conversations with Aiyuk but said he hopes Aiyuk will be a good addition to the Commanders.

“That’s between us, personal, but yeah, we did chat,” Daniels said. “He works hard. Before his knee injury he was All-Pro, very explosive, big catch radius, so excited for him to have a fresh start, new opportunity to prove himself day in and day out.”

Aiyuk hasn’t played in more than two years, but he was once one of the best receivers in the NFL. If Aiyuk can play at anything close to the level he used to play at, he can be a significant addition to the Commanders’ offense. Daniels is excited about that possibility.

sports.title: T.J. Lang blasts "despicable" Aaron Rodgers comments about Mike McCarthy
sports.summary: T.J.
sports.body:
Lang sharply criticized Rodgers for his decision to go public with issues that should have stayed in the Pittsburgh locker room.

“ I think it’s despicable ,” Lang said on 97.1 The Ticket in Detroit, via Sean Keeley of Awful Announcing . “I think that Aaron Rodgers just became everything that he has bitched about and moaned about over the last 10 years with former coaches, former teammates, airing grievances out, giving opinions out in the media.

“He has blacklisted, I don’t know how many, former teammates from just simple comments telling the truth because he just — he was sick of it. Oh, I thought this, and it wasn’t that.’ And I’m sick, man.

“I’ve been in a group chat with a whole lot of former teammates that feel the exact same way that I do.”

Most football players would feel that way. There’s a code in the locker room. Rodgers violated it.

“Mike McCarthy was my head coach for 8 years, and I love Mike McCarthy,” Lang said. “And I talked to Mike McCarthy on Monday night, and still have a great relationship with him.

“I haven’t talked to Aaron Rodgers in probably 5 years. I can’t remember the last time he returned a text. I don’t have a relationship with him. And I think it’s just absolutely despicable what he just did to Big Mike.”

Rodgers isn’t a whistleblower. He’s a troublemaker. He didn’t get his way, so he emptied a can of gasoline and tossed a match over his shoulder on the way out the door.

sports.title: Rams shut down Packers in second half for a 26-13 win in NFL's first Thanksgiving Eve game

sports.body:
Blake Corum ran for 151 yards and a score in final 30 minutes and the Rams defense shut out the Packers to pave the way to a 26-13 win. The victory is the fifth in a row for the Rams and they are now 7-4 with a Thursday night home game against the Chiefs on deck in Week 13.

The win moves the Rams ahead of the Packers in the race for NFC playoff spots and Thursday’s game between the Lions and Bears will have further impact on the chances for all four teams to advance to the postseason.

Corum’s touchdown came at the end of the Rams’ first possession of the second half and he finished the game with a career-high 32 carries for 184 yards.

That scoring drive ate up more than eight minutes. The Packers had a quick three-and-out, but briefly showed some life when linebacker Ty’Ron Hopper picked off Matthew Stafford to set the offense up in Los Angeles territory. Jordan Love turned the ball right back over when he hung a deep pass that safety Jaylen McCullough snagged out of the air. The Rams would then ride Corum and Kyren Williams on a pair of drives that covered more than 11 minutes.

The Packers’ last chance came with 6:13 left and they moved the ball to midfield before Love threw his second interception of the game. Cornerback Emmanuel Forbes got that one and the Packers were out of timeouts well before the two-minute warning.

Sticking with the ground game helped to limit Packers defensive end Micah Parsons’s impact in his return from last season’s torn ACL. He had a sack late in the first half, but Stafford only threw eight times after the break and the Packers’ run defense could not get their offense the ball often enough to get back into the game.

Love was 17-of-29 for 198 yards and a touchdown, but clearly missed wide receiver Christian Watson after he left the game with a concussion. They only picked up two first downs after halftime and they’ll hope that an extended break before their Week 13 trip to New Orleans is enough time for him to return to action.

The Rams have several injuries of their own to monitor as guard Bill Murray joined tight ends Davis Allen and Tyler Higbee in making early exits from the game. They’d like to have all those players back next week, but they showed on Wednesday night that Corum can sometimes be enough all by himself.

Corum ran nine time for 35 yards during a 15-play Rams drive and the final yard he picked up was a touchdown that broke a tie and put the Rams up 13-10. The drive opened the third quarter and ate up eight minutes of playing time.

The Rams faced three third downs on the drive and had Matthew Stafford throw to wide receiver Konata Mumpfield each time. The first two were completions that picked up 30 yards and the third was initially ruled a touchdown on the field. Replays showed Mumpfield did not have control of the ball in the end zone, but the Rams still got a first down due to a defensive holding penalty on the day.

Corum has 16 carries for 58 yards and Mumpfield has four catches for 69 yards.

sports.title: Christian Watson ruled out with a concussion
sports.summary: Rams safety Kamren Kinchens was disqualified for the hit that injured Watson.
sports.body:
Watson went to the locker room for a concussion evaluation shortly before halftime and the Packers announced that he has been ruled out at the start of the second half. Watson had four catches for 65 yards and a touchdown prior to his injury.

The Rams also lost safety Kamren Kinchens for the rest of the game on the same play. Kinchens was ejected for a helmet-to-helmet hit on Watson.

Rams tight end Davis Allen has also been ruled out with an ankle injury.

The two teams went to the break tied 13-13 and that remains the score early in the third quarter.

sports.title: Here's a roadmap to the Aaron Rodgers developments, one of the craziest stories in years
sports.summary: If you were traveling on Wednesday or otherwise not plugged in for one of the most rollicking, unpredictable days in years if not ever, you're in luck.
sports.body:
We’ve reconstructed the full timeline as to the events regarding now-former Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers.

It actually started on Monday, when coach Mike McCarthy was asked whether he has considered using one of the team’s other three quarterbacks when the offense is struggling. McCarthy, whose body language in hindsight suggests he was dreading the question , said without equivocation, “ Aaron Rodgers is our quarterback .”

On Tuesday, Rodgers took his usual reps at practice. He conducted his usual midweek press conference. Unbeknownst to most of the media or the general public, the Steelers were changing their play-calling procedures to have quarterbacks coach Tom Arth, and not McCarthy, communicate the calls to Rodgers through the speaker in his helmet.

Then came Tuesday night. At 11:10 p.m. ET, the Steelers issued a statement — not from coach Mike McCarthy or G.M. Omar Khan or owner Art Rooney II but from team spokesman Burt Lauten — that Mason Rudolph will start on Friday against the Broncos and Rodgers will be inactive.

The news forced the Broncos to make a quick pivot in their preparations from Rodgers to Rudolph. As one source put it, the Broncos weren’t sure whether it was a good thing or a bad thing .

It was definitely a bad thing, all things considered, for the Steelers.

By Wednesday morning, reports emerged that it was a coach’s decision . At 8:00 a.m. ET, McCarthy informed the team of the decision.

Enter Pat McAfee. He teased a surprise guest at 1:40 p.m. ET. As expected, it was Rodgers.

sports.title: Micah Parsons gets first sack of season, Packers and Rams tied 13-13 at halftime
sports.summary: Parsons's sack came just before end of the first half in Los Angeles.
sports.body:
Parsons made his return from a torn ACL against the Rams and had a couple of pressures early in the game. He got home for a sack of Matthew Stafford on the Rams’ first play after a Trey Smack field goal tied the score at 13-13 with 1:50 to play in the half.

The Rams ran out the clock from there and they will get the ball to start the second half at SoFi Stadium.

Parsons’s sack was part of an eventful final couple of minutes. Rams safety Kamren Kinchens was ejected for a hit to the head of Packers wide receiver Christian Watson and Watson is now being evaluated for a concussion. It would be a big loss for the Packers as Watson has four catches for 65 yards and a touchdown so far on Wednesday night.

Running back Kyren Williams scored the Rams’ only touchdown, but their offense slowed down after picking up points on each of their first three possessions. Stafford is 12-of-15 for 98 yards while Williams and Blake Corum have 35 yards on nine carries.

Packers quarterback Jordan Love is 12-of-18 for 154 yards. The Packers will be hoping for right guard Kevin Zeitler’s return from an ankle injury while waiting for more word on Watson and the Rams called tight end Davis Allen to return from an ankle injury.

sports.title: Rams S Kamren Kinchens ejected for hit on Christian Watson
sports.summary: Rams safety Kamren Kinchens was ejected from Wednesday night's game against the Packers after a hit on wide receiver Christian Watson.
sports.body:
Per the Netflix broadcast, the league office said that Kinchens was ejected for leaving his feet and making helmet-to-helmet contact with Watson and NFL executive vice president Troy Vincent made the final call on disqualifying him from the game.

Watson held onto the ball, but went to the locker room with members of the medical staff and the catch did not count because Packers wideout Matthew Golden was flagged for offensive pass interference to offset the Kinchens foul.

The play came on a fourth-and-1 and the Packers ultimately opted to kick a field goal rather than go for it again. It is now 13-13 with under two minutes to play in the half.

sports.title: Jordan Love, Christian Watson cut Rams lead to 13-10
sports.summary: The points keep coming in the first half at SoFi Stadium.
sports.body:
A little more than three minutes after the Rams scored their first touchdown of the night, the Packers paid their first visit to the end zone. Jordan Love hooked up with Christian Watson for a six-yard score that cut the Rams’ lead to 13-10 with just over eight minutes to play in the half.

Watson also caught a pass on the first play of the drive and that completion went for 21 yards. Love hit Watson’s fellow wideout Matthew Golden for a 39-yard gain on the next play and the quarterback scrambled for the third first down of the possession a couple of plays after that big gain.

The Packers went three-and-out and turned the ball over on their first two possessions, but they are now outgaining the Rams thanks to back-to-back scoring drives.

sports.title: Kyren Williams makes it 13-3 Rams in second quarter
sports.summary: The Rams have had the ball three times and all three drives have ended in points.
sports.body:
Running back Kyren Williams finished off the third possession with a seven-yard sprint into the end zone that pushed the Rams’ lead over the Packers to 13-3 with 11:29 to play in the first half. It’s the first time the Rams have scored on their first three possessions this season and it’s also the first time the Packers have allowed their opponents points on their first three drives.

Most of the other movement on the drive came through the air. Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford completed passes to Williams, tight end Davis Allen, wide receiver Konata Mumpfield, and tight end Tyler Higbee for first downs before Williams’s touchdown. The throw to Williams came just before Stafford took a hit from Packers defensive end Micah Parsons.

Stafford is 10-of-12 for 87 yards while Jordan Love is 6-of-10 for 70 yards, including a 32-yarder to Christian Watson that set up Trey Smack’s 54-yard field goal.

sports.title: Rams extend lead to 6-0 after Tucker Kraft fumble
sports.summary: The Rams doubled their lead after forcing the first turnover of Wednesday night's game.
sports.body:
Linebacker Nate Landman punched the ball out of tight end Tucker Kraft’s hands and safety Quentin Lake recovered the ball on the Rams’ 43-yard-line. The play came one snap after a Kam Curl interception was wiped out by an illegal contact penalty.

The Rams picked up a first down when Packers defensive tackle Devonte Wyatt was flagged for roughing Matthew Stafford and added another on a 15-yard pass to Konata Mumpfield. Packers defensive end Micah Parsons pressured Stafford into an incompletion on the next play and a botched backward pass cost the Rams six yards before they settled for Brandon McManus’s second field goal.

sports.body: Well, the NFL went and found reason to schedule a game on a Wednesday, crowning what’s certain to become it’s own brand of holiday with what’s been dubbed “The Thanksgiving Eve” game. In the early decades of the NFL preceding the 1940s — back when lights on funny looking cars, street lamps, and those indoors were still sometimes powered by oil and kerosene, and a short while later by carbide gas — Wednesday games were not unusual. Since 1940? Before tonight, six NFL games of notoriety were played on a Wednesday in the last 86 years, and none from 1949 through 2011. Do you know when the most recent game was played before this evening’s matchup? * September 22, 1948: Los Angeles Rams vs. Detroit Lions (First Wednesday game after 1940) * September 5, 2012: Dallas Cowboys vs. New York Giants (Moved from Thursday to avoid President Obama’s DNC speech) * December 2, 2020: Baltimore Ravens vs. Pittsburgh Steelers (COVID-19-rescheduled game) * December 25, 2024: Kansas City Chiefs vs. Steelers (Christmas Day game) * December 25, 2024: Ravens vs. Houston Texans (Christmas Day game) * September 9, 2026: Seattle Seahawks vs. New England Patriots (2026 NFL season opener ahead of Thursday game in Australia) Yesterday’s NFL is not today’s NFL, and with each of today’s games put in front of scores of holiday eyes, new interest grows. The move lately has been to put juicy matchups in the best slots of each major holiday. But tonight? This evening, the Los Angeles Rams, Green Bay Packers, and the NFL get a new “holiday” all to themselves. Okay, maybe they’ll have to fight for the attention of people out at informal high school reunions, but you know the game’s going to be on even at Applebee’s. (The impetus for that behemoth’s name is as thrilling as you might guess.) But here we are as a species, soaking in every single second of NFL football available to us. Truth be told, tonight’s game has real potential to be great. Two 6-4 teams are fighting to remain in playoff contention, with Green Bay hanging on to the seventh (and last) seed in the current NFL playoff race. If the regular season ended today, the Rams would be watching the postseason from home as the ninth seed in the NFC. Rooting interests? It’s another NFC-NFC game, so nothing carries too much weight. sports.body: The Buffalo Bills have ruled no one out for Thursday night. The Kansas Chiefs, on the other hand, will be without two starters and a defensive depth piece come Thanksgiving night. While the Bills haven’t made any official decisions on who is – or more accurately, who is not – playing tomorrow, they do have some question marks at key positions. There aren’t any surprises, however, on the week’s final injury report. [Media: https://twitter.com/BuffaloBillsPR/status/2125660875080274406?a=8WkBYLt6AG8DoW14dd0&s=20] What we’re thinking Dalton Kincaid will be a true game time decision. A stiff ankle in the cold, or more importantly slippery wet conditions, can be concerning, but it’s something they will likely keep testing right up until 6:50 when they have to make those inactive announcements. Dorian Williams and Christian Benford, on the other hand, are more likely to be game day decisions. Soft tissue injuries aren’t fun. Rest heals them, but cold temperatures can make those muscles tense up, and cause less-than stellar play at best with a setback in recovery a likely scenario. I would think they will know early on in the day how they are feeling and if it’s safe to put them on the field. Expect to see both Tre’Davious White and Shaq Thompson called up from the practice squad again. The game time roster will probably look pretty close to identical to last week’s. And that roster wasn’t terrible. Andy Reid announced early on Wednesday that the Chiefs will be playing without Kenneth Walker III. Walker has been averaging 5.48 yards per carry and has seven touchdowns. Not the same scoring production as James Cook, but close enough to be a problem for opponents. Instead, it will be Emmett Johnson who is averaging a yard less per carry and has only touched the ball 71 times this season in the backfield for Kansas City When the Chiefs published their injury report, it also had Jaylon Moore and Omarr Norman-Lott listed as not playing. This will be third game Moore has missed with an ankle injury. Not ideal for a Chiefs offensive line tasked with keeping Greg Rousseau away from Patrick Mahomes. [Media: https://twitter.com/goldmctNFL/status/2125643394185679009?a=LkcgLByeY-golJVTHwI&s=20] As a reminder, teams are required to announce their inactive list an hour and a half before kick off. For tomorrow’s game, that means we will be checking our notifications at 6:50pm EST.

sports.body:
After flirting a couple of times with landing under .500 in a given week of picks, it finally happened. For Week 11, I went 6-7.

That’s what I get for trying to pick upsets. In Week 11, it was Chalk City — and 12 of 13 home teams won.

And so, from now on, I’m not getting cute. I’m sticking with my first impulse. I’m not overthinking it. The first number that pops into my head will be the pick.

For the year, I’m at 102-60-1. The success rate is still 62.5 percent. Here’s hoping I can find a way to push it a little higher with the 16 games to be played from Wednesday through Monday.

Sean McVay is 0-5 against Matt LaFleur. A loss on Wednesday night would put the preseason favorites in grave danger of missing the playoffs, especially in light of an upcoming schedule that includes games against the Chiefs, the 49ers, the Cowboys, the Seahawks (twice), and the Buccaneers.

It’s the biggest early-window Thanksgiving game ever, with both teams at 8-2. Ben Johnson’s Bears gave up 52 points during last year’s visit to Ford Field. They’ll be determined to achieve a different result this time, in what becomes a true litmus test for the new-look Bears. If they’re truly contenders, this is a game they win.

It won’t be a cakewalk. For Philly, it’s the closest they’ll get this year to a game with a postseason vibe. But the Cowboys have a chance to make a run at the Giants — if Dallas can also hold off the Commanders.

Josh Allen is 5-0 against Patrick Mahomes in the regular season, 0-4 against Mahomes in the postseason. The trend continues, thanks to conditions that are more conducive to Allen making the right throw at the right time.

sports.title: New York Jets News: Did Jets win the Aaron Rodgers Debate After Steelers Benching Decision?
sports.summary: Aaron Glenn’s first big decision when he became the New York Jets head coach was Aaron Rodgers’ future. Rodgers was interested in returning, but the feeling wasn’t mutual. AG told Rodgers to hit the road, and they parted ways. Rodgers ended up signing with the Pittsburgh Steelers, and that is where
sports.body: Aaron Glenn’s first big decision when he became the New York Jets head coach was Aaron Rodgers’ future. Rodgers was interested in returning, but the feeling wasn’t mutual. AG told Rodgers to hit the road, and they parted ways. Rodgers ended up signing with the Pittsburgh Steelers, and that is where he has been since 2025. Late on Tuesday, November 24 NFL Insider Tom Pelissero revealed “The Steelers are benching Aaron Rodgers and naming Mason Rudolph the starting quarterback for Friday’s game against the Broncos. Sources say this was a coach’s decision. But Rodgers has struggled and now Mike McCarthy is making a change.” [Media: https://twitter.com/TomPelissero/status/2125442796467417433] “Aaron Rodgers will be inactive Friday, and now has potentially played the final snap of his legendary 22-year career,” Pelissero added. Now feels like a perfect time to look back and judge whether the Jets made the right decision. In 2025 the Jets finished with a 3-14 record and Justin Fields delivered an uneven season before getting benched. He started nine games, completed 62.7% of his passes, threw for 1,259 passing yards, and had seven touchdowns to one interception. He also toted the rock 71 times for 383 rushing yards and four touchdowns on the ground. Pittsburgh had a 10-7 record in 2025 and made a trip to the playoffs, but ended up losing in the wildcard round. Aaron Rodgers started 16 games last season. He completed 65.7% of his passes, threw for 3,322 passing yards and had a 24 touchdown to seven interception ratio. It seems pretty obvious that Rodgers would have been a dramatic upgrade over what the Jets trotted out at QB last year. Things in 2026 feel quite the opposite. Before Rodgers got benched he started 10 games this year. He completed 60.9% of his passes, threw for 2,241 passing yards, and had a 16 touchdown to six interception ratio. The Jets are getting much better QB play than that with Geno Smith at the helm. Smith has started all 11 games so far this season. He has completed 68.1% of his passes, has thrown for 2,402 passing yards, and has a 15 touchdown to three interception ratio. Seems like the Jets are better off with Smith in 2026 than Rodgers.
